name: Q-Works KUMAMOTO (Kumamoto)

This is the entrance to the site.

Q-Works KUMAMOTO is under the elevated tracks of JR Kumamoto Station.

name: Chigalab
card: A community with bookshelves and a kitchen, three minutes from Chigasaki Station
title: Chigalab — a place where new “schemes” are born from people's connections, three minutes from Chigasaki Station
lead: Chigalab is a coworking space on the 5th floor of the Warashina Building in Shin'eicho, a three-minute walk from Chigasaki Station on the JR Tokaido Line. It describes itself as “a community in Shonan and Chigasaki where new ‘schemes’ are born from people's connections”. Its free-seating workspace comes with bookshelves, sofa seats, focus booths, a kitchen and a meeting room. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: JR Tokaido Line Chigasaki Station, 3 min walk
¥800 for 2 hours / ¥1,500 for 4 hours / ¥2,200 per day
concept: New “schemes” born from people's connections
Chigalab is a coworking space run as a community for Shonan and Chigasaki. Its official website says it will “build a community that values long-term relationships”.
The founder's greeting includes the line “Life is made of happy accidents and chance encounters.” It is presented less as a place to rent a seat and more as one that values chance meetings.
steps: Free seating — pick the spot you like
The coworking area is free seating. Besides power and Wi-Fi, there is a printer, external monitors, a projector, chargers, book stands and stationery.
Drinks include drip coffee and Shonan mandarin and tomato juices.
The facility guide shows a bookshelf named “My Bookshelf”. Alongside the work seats, there are sofa seats.
The bookshelves and sofas add a place to unwind to a place for work.
For when you want to focus, and when you want to talk
There are focus booths for working alone, and a bookable meeting room at ¥700 per 30 minutes for members and ¥1,000 for others.
There is a kitchen on site. The price list also includes a “Challenge Kitchen” plan for fixed use at lunch or dinner on 4–5 days a month.

word.title: What is drop-in?
body: Using a coworking space by the hour or the day without registering as a member.
At Chigalab, you can use it without membership for ¥800 for two hours, ¥1,500 for four hours or ¥2,200 a day.

credits: Chigalab official website: “Facilities & access”, “What is Chigalab?”, “Menu & prices”

name: Rembrally Cafe
card: Work in a timed self-service café in a hotel annex
title: Rembrally Cafe — a timed self-service café in a hotel annex
lead: Rembrally Cafe is on the ground floor of the annex of Rembrandt Hotel Ebina, about an eight-minute walk from Ebina Station on the Odakyu and Sotetsu lines. It is a timed self-service café designed for remote work, workations and coworking. There are counter seats by the windows, sofa seats and a Camp Base area for breaks, plus about 500 manga and a free drink bar. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: Rembrandt Hotel Ebina annex, ground floor
Odakyu & Sotetsu lines Ebina Station, about 8 min walk / JR Sagami Line Ebina Station, about 10 min
concept: A “third place” with the added value only a hotel can offer
Rembrally Cafe is presented as a “third place” that is neither home nor work. It is a timed self-service café designed for remote work, workations and coworking.
There are no staff on site. You enter, leave and pay through the smartphone cashless service “Threes”. To pay in cash, apply at the hotel front desk.
steps: The window counter, for when you need to focus
The counter seats by the window suit focused solo work. They are the only seats with USB ports.
There are 30 seats in all, with free Wi-Fi and power outlets.
Sofa seats for working at ease
Sofa seats are for when you want to work in a relaxed way.
A Camp Base area for breaks and naps
The Camp Base area is a place to rest or nap between work. It is not counted in the 30 seats.
There are about 500 popular manga, including new releases, which you can read in a hanging chair.
A free drink bar and timed pricing
There is a free drink bar with a range of hot and iced drinks, plus a mini snack bar. You can bring your own food and drink, and the hotel's takeaway menu and delivery are also available.
Cashless use costs ¥250 for the first 30 minutes, then ¥125 per 15 minutes, up to ¥1,500 a day (incl. tax).

word.title: What is a third place?
body: A third place to be that is neither home (the first place) nor work (the second place).
Rembrally Cafe offers a new option for working in Ebina, as a “third place” with the added value of a hotel.

name: Jupiter Flexible Office
card: 24-hour coworking with orange lighting and paintings
title: Jupiter Flexible Office — 24-hour coworking in Sagamihara
lead: Jupiter Flexible Office is in Yokoyama, Chuo Ward, Sagamihara, a 15-minute walk from Kamimizo Station on the JR Sagami Line. The ground-floor coworking space has café seats, counter seats, business-meeting seats, individual booths and central seats, plus six lockable fully private rooms. It is open 24 hours. Everything below is based on the official website.
facts: JR Sagami Line Kamimizo Station, 15 min walk / bus from the South Exit of JR Yokohama Line Sagamihara Station, 12 min, to “Koko Iriguchi” or “JA Sagamihara-shi Mae”, then 1 min walk
Open space ¥165 per 15 min / ¥3,300 per day
concept: A ground-floor coworking space where members connect
Jupiter's ground floor is presented as a coworking space where members can connect. With many kinds of seat, you can choose by task or mood.
There is free stationery and cables, a magazine corner and a water server, plus a snack corner stocked with treats brought in by members.
steps: Café seats with orange light and paintings
This is the corner where you can eat and drink. The official website describes “warm orange lighting and paintings that evoke nature”. It works for lunch or a tea break too.
Seats looking out, and seats under a large painting
The counter seats, looking out through large windows, are popular.
The central seats are marked by a large painting and look out over the whole space.
Central seats beneath a large painting
Seats for meetings, and seats to focus alone
The business-meeting seats are roomy four-person seats, suited to quick business talks.
The individual booths are popular single seats that feel open yet let you focus alone.
There are six lockable fully private rooms; drop-in use costs ¥880 for the first hour, then ¥220 per 15 minutes.
The full monthly membership is ¥13,200 for 24-hour access. There are also weekday-morning-only, evening-only and weekend/holiday-only plans.

word.title: What is a fully private room?
body: A private room closed off by walls and a door, separating your space from other users. It suits web meetings and calls.
Jupiter has six lockable fully private rooms with Wi-Fi and power.

credits: Jupiter Flexible Office official website: “Coworking space”, “Access”, “Prices”, “Company profile”
